key_insight: ConTex turns counterfactual generation for time-series forecasting from slow, instance-specific optimization into a single learned intervention strategy that is consistent, sparse, and real-time.
engineering_relevance: This makes forecasting models more actionable for decision support systems by showing when, where, and how inputs should change to reach a desired future outcome.
method: Model-agnostic decomposed architecture for forecasting explanations
Two prediction heads: temporal relevance and modification strength
evidence_signal: Across multiple forecasting architectures and benchmark datasets, the method reports state-of-the-art validity, sparse counterfactuals, and 12–36x lower computation with about 0.007 s inference time.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality and representativeness of the training data for learning a globally consistent intervention strategy, so distribution shift may reduce explanation reliability.
paper_title: ConTex: Reformulating Counterfactual Generation For Time Series Forecasting
